purpose: Acquisition/review inventory only; NOT a provider-calendar manifest; never loaded by application

status_definitions.VERIFIED: Complete concrete primary evidence, retained bytes, historical temporal applicability, provider universe and independent review all established
status_definitions.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: Concrete reviewable historical calendar facts proved, but one or more required dimensions incomplete; ineligible for resolver
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Required historical calendar facts not substantiated; generic API documentation is insufficient
status_definitions.CONFLICTING: Relevant concrete sources disagree and conflict remains unresolved; ineligible for resolver
status_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: Dated authoritative evidence proves the combination/period is inapplicable; absence of data is insufficient

DHAN_PUBLIC.scope: Primary provider API documentation only: active expiries; no historical listing archive, publication time or cutoff evidence.

BSE_PUBLIC.scope: Official site shell, not a dated circular or historical contract list.

MCX_PUBLIC.scope: Access-denied response; NOT exchange contract evidence.

DHAN_EXPIRY.evidence_type: current endpoint implementation, not archived historical responses

DHAN_MASTER.evidence_type: current master endpoint; historical versions and publication proofs missing

ANGEL_MASTER.evidence_type: current cached master; historical complete-universe snapshots missing

UPSTOX_EXPIRED.evidence_type: third-provider retrospective expired-expiry list; not proof for Dhan/AngelOne

NSE_HOLIDAY.coverage: 2026 only, as declared in artifact; independent authenticity review missing
NSE_HOLIDAY.evidence_type: declared NSE holiday data; COM is not verified MCX

DHAN_DAYS.evidence_type: observed index trading days; no official holiday, complete contract universe or option cutoff proof

EXCHANGE_CIRCULARS.evidence_type: official dated NSE/BSE/MCX contract specifications, amendments, holiday/special-session and cutoff circulars must be obtained

NSE_CIRCULAR_INDEX.scope: Discovery locator only; no circular downloaded

requirements.HISTORICAL_UNIVERSE: Declare requested as-of coverage [start,end) first (owner has not specified a window). Obtain the complete provider-listed eligible expiry set at every T, including maturities beyond end for NEXT; include additions, withdrawals and corrections. Do not derive a weekday/monthly list.
requirements.TRADING_CALENDAR: Archive official venue/segment trading dates, holidays, special sessions, emergency closures and dated contract-rule changes. Observed candle days or another exchange holiday list are insufficient.
requirements.PUBLICATION_LISTING: Retain original provider response/master/document bytes, source locator, capture/publication timestamps with timezone, each contract listing/delisting timestamp, effective interval, version, completeness proof, and SHA-256. Publication by T must be proved independently of a later download.
requirements.EXPIRY_CUTOFF: Obtain official last-trading date and exact time/timezone for each option contract, including holiday shifts/amendments. Do not assume 15:30, end-of-day, or futures expiry minus a business-day count.
requirements.DHAN_IDENTITY: Archive Dhan instrument/underlying security IDs and segment mapping for the historical interval and original full expiry-list responses. Current successful live lists cannot establish past availability.
requirements.ANGEL_IDENTITY: Archive AngelOne instrument master versions with token, name, instrumenttype, exchange segment, option expiry and publication/listing evidence. An individual captured option subset is not a complete calendar.
requirements.MCX_UNDERLYING: For each main/mini product separately, prove the option-to-underlying-future mapping, dated futures security/token IDs and option cutoff. A futures expiry or main-contract calendar alone is insufficient for the option/mini.
requirements.INDEPENDENT_REVIEW: An independent reviewer must compare every normalized field and completeness/temporal claim to retained source bytes; record reviewer, review date, locator, hashes and signed/traceable disposition. Never mark VERIFIED based on code comments, schema validity or synthetic tests.
requirements.LIFECYCLE: Obtain dated launch, cessation, rename/restructure, weekly/monthly introduction/withdrawal and contract amendment notices; link old/new IDs only when officially proved. Record NOT_APPLICABLE only with evidence, never from absence.
requirements.METALS_SUPPORT: Registry FUTURE identity is not proof of provider historical listing or option support. Obtain separate FUTURE universe/cutoffs; prove any OPTION type/feed before adding it. Mini and main are distinct.
